_metadata.description: Personal AI Scheduled Messages Bot Executor Rule Template
notes: All Google Apps Script {{WEB_APP_URL}} callbacks intentionally use GET. Jira Automation POST requests to Apps Script ContentService can stop on the 302 redirect to script.googleusercontent.com.

The initial getBotMessageCurrentTime call uses autoMarkOnFetch=api so AgentTask / AI Report / custom API only write claimed (⏳ 已领取待确认), not final ✅. Final success is written by confirmBotMessageTriggered after the downstream call succeeds.
When getBotMessageCurrentTime returns executed=true, a Log action records messageId/topic/pushMethod/targetType/executionKey/rowIndex in the rule audit log before AgentTask/Bot/AsMe/AI branches run.

AgentTask and custom API branches call confirmBotMessageTriggered after a successful downstream webhook. If the rule times out or 404s before confirm, Sheet stays claimed (not fake ✅); AgentTask may reclaim (at-least-once), custom API stays at-most-once until claim TTL expires as trigger_delivery_failed.
API branches forward X-User-Id from Apps Script so memory-service write endpoints can keep per-user execution ledgers.
API forwarding keeps literal http/https prefixes in Jira Rule URLs because Jira Automation rejects URL fields that are only smart-value variables.
Bot private/group webhooks go through Dify botman jumpboard (BOTMAN_DIFY_*) because Jira cannot reach botman.int.rclabenv.com.

Bot private inputs.email is webhookResponse.body.botmanEmail. Apps Script builds that from Glip_User_Name as userId@ringcentral.com. userName is also passed as personName for compatibility with an older Apps Script response. Do not send initiator.emailAddress or @reply.ringcentral.glip.com as the Botman recipient.
AgentTask execute goes through Dify agent-task jumpboard (AGENT_TASK_DIFY_*) because Jira cannot reach memory-service; Chrome AR still calls memory-service directly.

AgentTask treats Dify workflow completion and downstream acceptance separately: only data.outputs.accepted=true confirms success; rejected outputs write trigger_delivery_failed plus the Dify error/status back to Sheet.

Multica AgentTask posts directly to the Autopilot webhook. The URL keeps a literal http:// or https:// prefix because Jira rejects a URL that is only a smart value. The scheme comes from the claim and must match the API origin. Do not print the URL or capability in the audit log. Confirm with stage=delivered only when status is accepted or duplicate and run_id is present. skipped or ignored confirms failure. Unknown responses stay claimed.
